rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithm-based rent-setting tools
rules.requirement: Bans property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
rules.coverage_text: Property owners and managers in San Francisco.
rules.citation: San Francisco Board of Supervisors legislation approved July 2024 (as described in Los Angeles City Council motion)
rules.quoted_span: In July 2024, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved legislation to ban property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
